messages:
carmen: Heads-up — we had a request from a couple of customers to make SLO state scannable in the compact list. specifically: show the effective threshold, current windowed value, and whether it's under a quiet window / muted. can we discuss API surface?

jake: @carmen do you mean the tenant list view (rows) or the expanded slo detail panel?

carmen: tenant list (compact rows). they want to triage quickly without opening each SLO. ideally a pill showing state + hover details.

liz: quick clarifying Qs — which fields do we need precomputed vs derived? my concern: computing windowed current on demand will be heavy.

sam: propose precompute for the compact view. fields: threshold, current_window_value, quiet_until, notify_enabled, noise_score (0-1), last_alert_ts. sample API sketch below.

sam: ```
GET /api/v1/slo/compact?tenant_id=acme
Response: [
  {
    "slo_id": "slo_123",
    "threshold": 0.99,
    "current": 0.965,
    "quiet_until": "2025-05-01T12:00:00Z",
    "notify": false,
    "noise_score": 0.72,
    "last_alert_ts": "2025-04-21T18:12:00Z"
  }
]
```

ops-bot: alerting-service: detected high error bursts for tenant=acme — routing fallback applied to model-tier=best-effort. :warning:

jake: main architectural question: noise_score calculation — do we compute in aggregator (backend) or approximate in frontend? strong preference: backend so it's a constant-time read for UI and we can version it.

liz: +1 backend. also we should expose which heuristic/version was used (e.g., noise_v2) so console can label it.

carmen: UX notes: show tri-color pill (green/amber/red) + small muted icon if quiet_until > now. click row to open SLO detail; add quick "unmute" action inline.

sam: implementation constraints: we shouldn't expand every existing slo payload. let's add a compact endpoint (pre-aggregated) and a flag in tenant settings to opt-in early. payload size budget: <2KB per tenant row. perf budget: 150ms tail for compact endpoint.

jake: rollout plan: canary to internal tenants -> 10% external -> full. track metrics: compact_fetch_latency, compact_payload_size, unmute_click_rate, false_unmute_rate.

liz: telemetry additions: per-route token counts, alert_fanout_count, last_alert_severity, and a boolean whether the last alert was suppressed by quiet-window. helps interpret noise_score spikes.

sam: also a backend note: ensure compact precompute honors per-tenant telemetry sampling / quotas to avoid blowing up our metric pipeline. samples => deterministic downsampling keyed by tenant.

carmen: ok action items: @jake open a small API contract PR with sample payload and perf targets; @sam add precompute task + sampling notes; @liz add telemetry field list and dashboards to track regressions. I'll draft UX mock and link in the PR.

jake: I'll open PR INF-2321 in a few hours. will include contract + canary flag.

sam: adding a comment on the PR about aggregator compute window and TTL for compact cache (suggest 30s).

liz: I'll create a small grafana panel to preview the telemetry we want.

carmen: thanks all — sounds good. let's try to ship a canary by next week. :thumbsup:
